problem_statement: Build a brand-new Services page at the route /services on the AkberJag portfolio template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router with createWebHistory, Tailwind CSS). The route does not exist yet in baseline (it renders blank). Construct the full page from scratch using the site's existing design system (Tailwind utility classes, the Space Mono font, the indigo `primary` colour palette from CSS custom properties, and the `bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-md` card styling used across the portfolio sections). Register /services as a standalone top-level route (a sibling of the language-scoped portfolio route) so it renders outside the scroll-snap portfolio shell. The page must include: (1) a header with an 'Our Services' title (h3), an intro paragraph, and a 'Book a consultation' button; (2) a service-category filter bar with three buttons - Web Development, UI/UX Design, Consulting; (3) a service panel that shows ONLY the active category's content. Web Development is active on first paint and shows a 'Web Development services' heading plus service cards ('Responsive Web Apps', 'Landing Pages'). Clicking the UI/UX Design category must reveal a 'UI/UX Design services' heading (h3) that is NOT present on the default Web Development view. The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile. Each of the three category filter buttons must carry a data-cat attribute identifying its category (data-cat="web" for Web Development, data-cat="design" for UI/UX Design, data-cat="consulting" for Consulting), so the active category can be selected by that attribute. Use the tailwind primary tokens for the accent colour (bg-primary-500 / text-primary-500 on the active/CTA controls).
required_content: Header with an 'Our Services' title (h3), an intro paragraph, and a 'Book a consultation' button
A category filter bar with three buttons: Web Development, UI/UX Design and Consulting
Web Development category (default/active): a 'Web Development services' heading (h3) plus service cards including 'Responsive Web Apps' and 'Landing Pages'
UI/UX Design category: a 'UI/UX Design services' heading (h3) with 'Design Systems' / 'Interactive Prototypes' cards, shown only after the UI/UX Design filter is clicked
Consulting category: a 'Consulting services' heading with 'Technical Audits' / 'Team Mentoring' cards, shown only after the Consulting filter is clicked
Only the active category's panel is rendered; switching categories swaps the visible panel
Responsive layout (cards stack on mobile, no horizontal overflow)
Each category filter button carries a data-cat attribute (web / design / consulting) identifying its category
design_constraints: Reuse Tailwind utility classes and the site's card styling (bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-lg shadow-md)
Reuse the site's indigo `primary` colour palette (text-primary-500 / bg-primary-500) exposed via CSS custom properties and the tailwind.config primary tokens
Reuse the Space Mono font and the dark-mode `selector` scheme (dark:*) used across the portfolio sections
Register the view as a standalone top-level route in src/router/index.js (sibling of the /:lang portfolio route, before the catch-all), so it renders outside the scroll-snap shell
Only render the active category's service panel so switching categories is an observable change
Give each category filter button a data-cat attribute (web / design / consulting) so the active category is selectable by attribute
Apply the primary accent tokens (bg-primary-500 for the active filter and the Book a consultation CTA, text-primary-500 for accent text)
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline registers /services as an EMPTY top-level route (component renders null) so the route is blank and check A holds; reference implements the full page with a working category filter that renders only the active category's panel; bad renders the same content but with an inert filter (no click handler) and every category panel stacked always-visible, so the 'UI/UX Design services' reveal delta never holds (interaction gate fails, DOM/overflow gates still pass -> discriminating on interaction only). Router uses createWebHistory so state_plan paths are plain /services. The genuine interaction: clicking the UI/UX Design filter (button[data-cat=design], selected via data-attr per gotcha #18l) swaps the rendered panel and reveals 'UI/UX Design services' (h3) which is absent from the default Web Development view; bad shows all panels unconditionally so changed_from cannot hold. Note: the template's router has a greedy `:section?` child route that would otherwise capture /services and render the home view - the explicit /services route is registered BEFORE it so the static path wins. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct. build = plain `vite build` (no vue-tsc), all three exit 0 offline; toolchain already modern (vite ^5.4, vue ^3.5) so gotcha #18s does not apply.
